bots.name: Variance Explainer
bots.tagline: Computes the NII, fee and opex bridge and writes commentary grounded only in those numbers.

steps.label: Close Sentinel succeeded
steps.result: Predecessor return value: period=2026-10

steps.label: Income & cost bridge by business line, down to Basware
steps.sql:
SELECT business_line, driver, act - bud AS effect
FROM SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.V_CIR_BRIDGE WHERE period = '2026-10'
UNION ALL
SELECT cost_centre, supplier, SUM(amount_eur) FROM SDP_AKTIA.PUBLIC.AKTIA_BASWARE_INVOICES
WHERE period = '2026-10' AND over_budget_driver GROUP BY 1, 2;
steps.result: YTD income EUR 217.4M vs 229.6M budget · opex EUR 136.0M vs 131.6M · largest driver: funding cost

steps.label: Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ EUR 0.5M)
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.CIR_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 5e5 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
steps.result: 5 drivers selected — funding cost, hedges, IT core banking, consultancy, life insurance

steps.label: AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
steps.result: Commentary drafted (176 words, English + Finnish) · numeric check: 12/12 figures match bridge

steps.label: Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
steps.result: Passed · 0 ungrounded figures

steps.label: Draft commentary to Variance Analysis + dashboard
steps.sql: INSERT INTO SDP_AKTIA.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('variance-analysis', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');
steps.result: Draft published (badge: Written by Variance Explainer)

guardrails.label: Grounding
guardrails.rule: Every figure in the text must exist in the bridge result

guardrails.label: Materiality
guardrails.rule: Only drivers above threshold are explained

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.T_VARIANCE_EXPLAINER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 2}'
AS
  CALL SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('variance-explainer');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Income & cost bridge by business line, down to Basware
SELECT business_line, driver, act - bud AS effect
FROM SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.V_CIR_BRIDGE WHERE period = '2026-10'
UNION ALL
SELECT cost_centre, supplier, SUM(amount_eur) FROM SDP_AKTIA.PUBLIC.AKTIA_BASWARE_INVOICES
WHERE period = '2026-10' AND over_budget_driver GROUP BY 1, 2;
-- step 3 · Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ EUR 0.5M)
SELECT * FROM SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.CIR_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 5e5 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
-- step 4 · AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
SELECT AI_COMPLETE('claude-sonnet-4-5',
  'Write CFO commentary using ONLY these figures: ' || OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::STRING)
FROM SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.CIR_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5;
-- step 5 · Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
SELECT SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.FN_NUMBERS_GROUNDED(:commentary, 'CIR_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5');
-- step 6 · Draft commentary to Variance Analysis + dashboard
INSERT INTO SDP_AKTIA.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('variance-analysis', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.T_ROLLING_FORECAST
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('rolling-forecast');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Retrain SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST per business line × income line
CREATE OR REPLACE SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.M_INCOME_FC(
  INPUT_DATA => TABLE(SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.V_INCOME_HISTORY), SERIES_COLNAME => 'series',
  TIMESTAMP_COLNAME => 'month', TARGET_COLNAME => 'income');
-- step 3 · Guardrail: backtest MAPE ≤ 4%
CALL SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.M_INCOME_FC!SHOW_EVALUATION_METRICS();
-- step 4 · Roll RF: actuals Jan–Oct + ML Nov–Dec
CALL SDP_AKTIA.PUBLIC.SP_ROLL_FORECAST(source_version => 'Q3F', new_version => 'RF10', actual_through => '2026-10');
-- step 5 · Promote RF10 to current forecast (approval)
CALL SDP_AKTIA.PUBLIC.SP_PROMOTE_VERSION('RF10', approved_by => :approver);

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.T_GL_MAPPER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 6 * * * Europe/Helsinki'
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('gl-mapper');

-- step 1 · Unmapped accounts detected
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SDP_AKTIA.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 2 · AI_CLASSIFY against group COA
SELECT account_code, AI_CLASSIFY(account_name || ' ' || sample_postings,
  (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(label) FROM SDP_AKTIA.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE is_leaf)) AS mapping
FROM SDP_AKTIA.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 3 · Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox
SELECT * FROM SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence < 0.92;
-- step 4 · Apply mappings + DMF on unmapped balance
INSERT INTO SDP_AKTIA.PUBLIC.MAP_GL_TO_PLAN SELECT ... FROM SDP_AKTIA.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;
